$schema-note: Every on-screen string of both apps. Generated into apps/ios/App/Localizable.xcstrings (+ App/Generated/Copy.swift) and apps/android/app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml by web/scripts/gen-mobile-copy.mjs. A value is a string, or an object: { text, args } for typed placeholders, { ios, android } for platform words, { count, one, other } for a plural (other names {count}). notPlural: true marks int placeholders that count no noun, so Android lint does not ask for a plural. {name} is a placeholder (a string unless args says int). Keys from design/specs/2026-10-30-mobile-apps.md section 13.

strings.account.delete.intro: Deleting your account removes what Forever Sixty holds about you:

strings.account.delete.item.characters: Your characters, their addon exports and sync history
strings.account.delete.item.sims: Your saved sims and builds, and the ratings derived from them

strings.account.delete.lose.premium: Your Premium plan is cancelled and does not renew.
strings.account.delete.lose.founder: Your founder price is gone for good. A plan taken later is billed at the full price.
strings.account.delete.lose.guildPlan: The {guild} plan you pay for is cancelled, and its seats end for every member.
